faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes CLS 320 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year and generation. Early C219 cars (2004–2006) used the M112 V6 petrol. Later C219 cars (2006–2010) used the M272 V6 petrol. From the C218 generation (2010–2018), the CLS 320 used the M272 petrol or, in diesel form, the OM642 V6. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes CLS 320 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Diesel engines (OM642) start from £2,800. Petrol engines (M112/M272) start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my CLS 320?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M112, M272 or OM642 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M112 CLS 320 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M112 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M272 CLS 320 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M272 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild OM642 CLS 320 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. We replace swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used CLS 320 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my CLS 320 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a CLS 320 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most CLS 320 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
